title: The top bar's Open app button and the Work page's Where it runs card link to the app main declares
description: A real browser opens the served dashboard over a repository whose main declares app.url in graphyard.json and whose serve pass serves main's commit. The top bar shows Open app linking to the declared address; the Work page's Where it runs card links to it too and shows the machine, the serving commit, when it was deployed and the dashboard's own link. Over a repository that declares no app.url the card names the one setting to add and no Open app button shows.

steps.name: master status lists main's app.url with machine, serving commit and deploy time, refuses loopback, names the missing setting
Open app and the Where it runs card, declared and missing
